summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments, including a mobile responsiveness issue with action buttons in UploadListItem not being visible on mobile.
summary.outcome: All 14 review threads across 3 rounds were resolved. The mobile actions fix was implemented in UploadListItem.tsx by adding a mobile-specific actions cell mirroring the FileListItem pattern, type-checked, committed, and pushed.

repo: FileListItem uses a .file-list-item-mobile-actions div (hidden on desktop, shown on mobile via grid-area: actions) to expose action buttons on mobile — UploadListItem must follow the same pattern.
.file-list-item-date has display:none on mobile, so any actions placed only in the date cell are invisible on mobile.
PR review workflow uses GraphQL for fetching/resolving threads and REST for posting reply comments (with --field for integer in_reply_to, not -f).

code.finding: Action buttons were only rendered in the desktop date cell; fix extracts them into a shared actionButtons variable and renders in both date cell and a new mobile-actions cell.

workflow: Batch resolve GraphQL mutations can handle multiple thread IDs in one call.
Run pnpm typecheck before committing after component edits to catch JSX/type errors early.

friction: Push required a retry (first push attempt failed).
Needed multiple grep passes to locate the correct CSS class pattern (.file-list-item-mobile-actions) before confirming the right approach.
